title: Crestline Fleet Account Billing Cycles, Net Terms and Early-Pay Schedule
content:
A Crestline Fleet Account is billed on one of the cycles its program offers, with the net terms, statement closing and early-pay figures below.

## Billing cycles and net terms

| Program | Billing cycles the account may use | Net terms (days) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | per-invoice billing | 15 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | per-invoice billing; monthly statement billing | 30 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | per-invoice billing; monthly statement billing | 30 |
| Crestline Fleet National | per-invoice billing; monthly statement billing | 30 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | monthly statement billing | 45 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | per-invoice billing; monthly statement billing | 45 |

Net terms are the days after the invoice date (per-invoice billing) or after the statement date (monthly statement billing) by which payment is due. On every program a monthly statement closes on the last day of the month.

## Early-pay discount

| Program | Early-pay discount (percent of the invoice amount) | Early-pay period (calendar days after the invoice date) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 1 | 10 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 1 | 10 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 2 | 10 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 0 | 0 |

The early-pay discount is the discount for paying an invoice in full within the early-pay period of the invoice date; the period is counted in calendar days after the invoice date. A figure of 0 in either column means the program offers none.

## Delivery and copies

| Program | How invoices and statements are delivered | Fee for a mailed paper copy of an invoice or statement (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | emailed PDF | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | emailed PDF | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | emailed PDF | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet National | EDI 810 or email | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | EDI 810 or email | 0.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | emailed PDF | 0.00 |

## Due-date illustration (hypothetical dates)

On a Crestline Fleet Starter account billed per invoice, an invoice dated the 3rd of a month carries net terms of 15 days, so it is due 15 days after the 3rd, on the 18th.
